thread:
Maya P.: FYI postmortem follow-up from yesterday's auth+model-registry blip. We need clear owners/timelines for mitigations, and a plan for recurring-pattern detection. TL;DR: auth provider expired tokens, model registry throttling. We avoided customer impact but it's a close call. @Jordan can you kick this off?

Jordan (oncall): incident-bot: Incident 2026-03-22T14:12Z — external-auth-provider outage (14m) — mitigated via fallback to internal token cache :white_check_mark:

Ricardo: assigning owners in JIRA now. I'll own 'model-registry throttling hardening' (TKT-3121) — goal: implement graceful degrade and cache priming. ETA: 2 weeks. @DevOps-Luis please take 'auth fallback policy and rotation' (TKT-3122).

DevOps-Luis: got it. I'll start with a short-term TTL refresher + rotate plan. Proposal: combine KMS-backed short-lived tokens + bloom filter for request throttling. ETA: 10 days. I'll open an infra PR with config snippet.

Priya: Suggest we add monthly runbook dry-runs for vendor outages and a recurring monitoring alert for 'increase in registry 429s' with a 1h rolling baseline. Assign to SRE rotation. Also add automated smoke checks for E2E model fetch.

Maya P.: Good. Also want SLA conversation with cloud/auth vendor — Ricardo, can you add vendor escalation steps and contract owner to the ticket? We should have an exec-level contact in place.

Ricardo: added vendor escalation steps and contact. Also adding an item: negotiate 99.9% auth SLA and penalty clause. Creating vendor sync meeting for next Tues.

Jordan (oncall): small note on recurring pattern: we saw auth token failures spiking at 02:00 UTC on two separate days last month. I'll add this to the postmortem and suggest correlating deploys or cron jobs.

DevOps-Luis: config snippet for quick review:
```
# quick fallback config
model_registry:
  primary: https://registry.redwood.ai
  fallback: s3://model-cache-region
  throttle_policy:
    max_rps: 1200
    burst: 500
auth:
  token_refresh: 300 # seconds
  caching: true
```

Priya: +1 on runbook drills. Can we get a recurring calendar invite? I'll volunteer to run the first tabletop.

Maya P.: Final ask: owners, JIRA tickets, and ship dates in by EOD tomorrow. We'll do weekly 15m follow-ups until all items are closed. Thanks everyone :pray:

sre-bot: Reminder set — followup-check TKT-3121,TKT-3122 scheduled in 7 days.
